QUOTE: "`token_hits`, which gives a per-token count. Matching is a conjunction, so one token with zero hits empties the whole query. The note names the culprit and says "RETRY WITHOUT THEM.""
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes the current graded behavior for single-token misses but never says a lone non-matching token was previously treated as proof of absence, or that this conflated "nothing exists" with "I did not look there."
